title: Geometry - Lesson 3 Practice: Parallelogram Properties
description: Practice using parallelogram side, angle, diagonal, and base-height properties.

questions.question: In parallelogram $ABCD$, $AB = 16$. What is $CD$?
questions.explanation: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are congruent, so $CD = AB = 16$.

questions.question: In a parallelogram, one angle measures $72^\circ$. What is the measure of a consecutive angle?
questions.explanation: Consecutive angles in a parallelogram are supplementary, so $180 - 72 = 108$.

questions.question: The diagonals of every parallelogram bisect each other.
questions.explanation: A key parallelogram property is that the diagonals cut each other into two congruent parts.

questions.question: Diagonals of parallelogram $PQRS$ intersect at $T$. If $PT = 11$, then $TR = $ ______.
questions.explanation: $PT$ and $TR$ are halves of the same diagonal, so they are congruent.

questions.question: A parallelogram has base $14$ cm and height $5$ cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Use $A = bh$. The area is $14(5) = 70$ square centimeters.

questions.question: In parallelogram $WXYZ$, $WX = 3x + 2$ and $YZ = 20$. Since they are opposite sides, $x = $ ______.
questions.explanation: Set opposite sides equal: $3x + 2 = 20$, so $3x = 18$ and $x = 6$.

questions.question: In parallelogram $JKLM$, $m\angle J = 118^\circ$. Find $m\angle K$ and explain the relationship used.
questions.correctAnswer: $m\angle K = 62^\circ$ because consecutive angles in a parallelogram are supplementary.
questions.explanation: $J$ and $K$ are consecutive angles, so their measures add to $180^\circ$. Thus $180 - 118 = 62$.

questions.question: A student says that if one half of diagonal $AC$ is $9$, then the whole diagonal $AC$ is $9$. Correct the student's reasoning.
questions.correctAnswer: The whole diagonal is $18$ because the diagonals bisect each other, so the other half of $AC$ is also $9$.
questions.explanation: Bisect means to split into two congruent parts. If one half is 9, the full diagonal is $9 + 9 = 18$.
